summary: Titanic victim and brother-in-law of architect Stanford White; John's 6th cousin 5x removed via Bull Smith.
bio:
Route (6C5R): Bull Smith → Richard Jr. (2d) → Sarah Woodhull → Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull → Elizabeth Woodhull Nicoll → Eliza Nicoll Smith → Judge J. Lawrence Smith → James. Born 1856 in Smithtown; lived in Paris; travelled first class on the Titanic and died in the sinking in 1912; his body was not recovered. His sister Bessie married Stanford White. (Birthplace, Paris residence, first-class travel and body-not-recovered details come from the project's research-thread answer to John's question 'who was James Clinch Smith?' (section 1.4); the research notes record only 'died on the Titanic'.)

Son of Judge J. Lawrence Smith; through his father's line (Job 1st -> Job 2d -> Anna -> Richard 4th -> Richard 5th -> J. Lawrence -> James) he is John's 5th cousin 5 times removed, closer than the 6C5R on the site, and a descendant of John's own ancestor Job Smith. He inherited his father's homestead (Pelletreau 1898, [R4-S1]); married the musician Bertha Ludington Barnes; witnessed the 1906 murder of his brother-in-law Stanford White; and died on the Titanic (Wikipedia, [R4-S2]).
notable: Died in the sinking of RMS Titanic, 1912.
